decisions.reason: The product fits the established modular offer and the firm's growth provides slack to carry it while results are still uncertain.
The product has its own page, indicating management commitment and likely satisfactory performance, so there is no shortfall triggering search.
As a close extension of the core offer, the product meets aspirations and the firm's slack allows continued support.
The product builds on established capabilities and, given organisational slack and growth, management sees no need to drop it yet.
